IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired (PD-INC-6612) — inference-frontend — severity: P1 — 95th percentile latency > 2.5s in eu-central-1. Primary oncall: Sophie. Link: <https://pagerduty.example/PD-INC-6612>
PagerDuty: Primary did not acknowledge within 3m. Escalating to secondary: Ravi and manager: Elena per policy.
Ravi: acked. on it. pulling up dashboards.
Sophie: sorry, phone was in airplane mode during a flight takeoff. jumping in now.
Ravi: quick snapshot -> grafana shows request lat p95 from 1.1s -> 3.4s in last 5m, increased 5xx errors from streaming-proxy. kubernetes shows one older canary replica set at 3/3 ready but huge CPU on pod streaming-svc-rc-7f8cd.
Sophie: any recent deploys to eu?
DeployBot: :information_source: Deploy event: streaming-stability-canary rolled at 3162011200 by qa/batch. Revision: 2026.03.14-42.
Ravi: rolling back canary to previous stable to isolate. runbook: inference-frontend/rollback-canary. executing:

```
# rollback canary
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/streaming-service --to-revision=41
```

Ravi: initiating feature gate disable for new streaming decode algorithm while rollback proceeds:

```
redwoodctl feature toggle set streaming-decode-new false --env eu-central-1
```

Sophie: logs from streaming-proxy show repeated "stream-session stalled: backend_recv_timeout" and a spike of "context-window-growth" messages. looks like some large requests overloaded the decoder.
Ravi: also seeing upstream KV-cache miss storm causing synchronous fetches to model store. the cache-miss ratio went 180% higher.
Elena: customer impact? should we notify support now?
Ravi: preliminary: about 8% of streaming sessions experienced stalls/timeouts between 3162011300 and 3162011600. most auto-reconnected, but a handful of sessions failed and customers may open tickets. duration ~6-9m depending on region.
Sophie: rollback complete according to deploybot.
DeployBot: :white_check_mark: Rollback applied: streaming-service -> revision 41. All pods restarted; readiness back to 100%.
Ravi: after rollback, p95 improved from 3.4s -> 1.4s within 90s, 5xx rate back to baseline.
Sophie: running cache warm-up on new pods to reduce cold misses:

```
# warm-up cache keys
kubectl -n infra exec deploy/streaming-service -- /bin/sh -c "/app/bin/cache_warmup --top-keys=1000"
```

Ravi: also adjusted autoscaler minReplicas from 3 -> 5 to handle the burst while we investigate. applied HPA patch.
Sophie: HPA command:

```
kubectl -n infra patch hpa streaming-service -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":5}}'
```

Elena: thanks. what's the suspected root cause? any correlation to recent PRs?
Ravi: early suspicion: combined effect of new streaming decode algorithm (more synchronous CPU/buffer usage) + cache-miss amplification due to a recently increased max-context-size setting merged 1 day ago (PR #2142). That increased memory pressure and serialized some request paths. The canary surfaced the issue under a real spike.
Sophie: will file follow-ups: INF-450 (revert max-context-size bump), INF-451 (backoff on streaming decode), INF-452 (cache miss alert + runbook). Assigning owners.
Ravi: will add an alert for sustained p95 > 2s in a region and for cache-miss-rate > 50% baseline. Also recommend making primary ack window a bit longer for mobile users during overnight flights? (noted).
Elena: ops -> prepare a proactive support note in case customers reach out. I'll draft the message.
Sophie: adding timeline to incident tracker:
- 3162011200: canary rolled
- 3162011305: pagerduty fired PD-INC-6612
- 3162011320: primary missed ack (airplane), secondary (Ravi) acked at 3162011330
- 3162011350: rollback started
- 3162011435: rollback complete; HPA minReplicas increased
- 3162011480: p95 recovered to baseline

IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Incident mitigated — PD-INC-6612 acknowledged by Ravi at 3162011330, resolved at 3162011480.
PagerDuty: Escalation summary: primary missed ack window due to device state -> secondary performed mitigation (rollback + autoscaler tweak) -> manager notified. Policy behaved as configured. Suggest follow-ups: mobile ack guidance, tighten canary checks for streaming decode changes, add cache-miss guardrails.
Elena: good work. Ravi/Sophie, please coordinate RCA and schedule follow-up with infra. I'll own customer comms. :thumbsup:
Ravi: filing RCA and follow-ups now.
Sophie: will close thread once RCA link is posted.
DeployBot: :memo: RCA ticket INF-453 created by Sophie: <https://tracker.example/INF-453>
Elena: leaving the channel — thanks team. :closed_lock_with_key:
